style: Editorial lifestyle photograph for the journal of Maison Maho, a travel-wear and lifestyle brand. Bright natural light, crisp shadows, fresh airy palette of white, ivory, sand, sea blue, terracotta and olive. Shot on 35mm film, shallow depth of field, natural skin, candid and unposed. Mediterranean coastal setting. Wide horizontal composition: the subject sits in the middle band of the frame with clear room above the head and below the feet, and the top and bottom fifths of the frame hold only background, because the picture is cropped to a 5:2 banner. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no borders.
